name: ETHIOPIAN_EUNUCH
canonical: the Ethiopian eunuch, a dignified African court official of Candace's treasury, deep dark-brown skin, a smooth full-cheeked clean-shaven noble face, richly dressed in fine layered robes of saffron and indigo and a jewelled gold headdress, seated upright in an ornate chariot holding an unrolled prophet's scroll covered only in faint vague illegible ancient script
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
